o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *agtar-.
Cognate with Turkmen agtarmak (“to search”), Uzbek axtarmoq (“to search”), Uyghur ئاختۇرماق (axturmaq, “to search through”), etc.

glosses: to look like, to look similar to
to smell like or taste of

o.text: Possibly same as above; however, considering the color-related sense, perhaps rather from Proto-Common Turkic *čāl (“grey”).
From Turkish ayar, from Arabic عِيَار (ʕiyār).
